request.state:
Icelandic original: „Ég finn öryggi og stolt í litlu bæjarfélaginu mínu. Mér finnst ég eiga mikið stærri þátt í öllu því sem tekur stað í heimbænum mínum.“
English gloss: “I find safety and pride in my small community. I feel I have a much larger role in everything that takes place in my home town.”

faithful.instructions: Is the English gloss a faithful translation of the Icelandic original, with no added or missing meaning?
